summary.background: In this paper, the effects of aggregate and curing temperature on strength development characteristics of UP (Unsaturated Polyester)-MMA (Methyl Methacrylate) based polymer mortar under sub-zero temperature are experimentally investigated to provide a criterion for repair and production of precast products.
summary.method: Strength development of polymer mortar is largely affected by curing temperature rather than aggregate temperature.
